name: slothgit
description: Lazygit-inspired power tools for VS Code's built-in Git: rewrite history from a commit list, amend older commits, manage stashes, browse the reflog.

slothgit.commitLimit.description: Maximum number of commits shown in the Commits list.

slothgit.reflogLimit.description: Maximum number of entries shown in the Reflog list.

slothgit.confirmRewritingPushedCommits.description: Ask for confirmation before rewriting commits that are already on the upstream branch.

slothgit.mainBranches.markdownDescription: Branches that count as the main branch, as in lazygit. Commits already on one (on its upstream, if it has one) are shown green, pushed commits yellow and unpushed ones red.

enumDescriptions: Always move stacked branches along (git rebase --update-refs)
slothgit.updateStackedBranches.markdownDescription: When history is rewritten, also move other local branches that point at the rewritten commits, such as branches stacked on top of each other (`git rebase --update-refs`, git 2.38 or later). Branches checked out in another worktree are left alone.

enumDescriptions: Most recently checked out first (lazygit default)
slothgit.branchSort.description: Order of local branches in the Branches panel. The current branch is always first.

slothgit.simpleMode.markdownDescription: Hide advanced actions (bisect, custom patches, worktrees, compare, resets, upstream settings, the Reflog and more) from the menus and buttons. They stay available in the Command Palette. Toggle it in the SlothGit tab's Status panel **…** menu.

viewsWelcome.contents:
SlothGit opens in a tab of its own: your files, branches, commits and stashes side by side, with the selected one's changes next to them.
[Open SlothGit](command:slothgit.open)
Right-click anything in the tab for what you can do with it.
[Get Started](command:slothgit.learn)

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with SlothGit
walkthroughs.description: What the SlothGit tab shows, and plain-language guides to Git features such as rebase, cherry-pick, worktrees and bisect.

steps.title: Where SlothGit lives
steps.description:
A tab with lazygit's panels side by side: Status, Files, Branches, Commits and Stash, the selected one's changes, and Simple Mode for fewer, everyday actions.
[Open SlothGit](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22commits%22%5D)

steps.title: Read the commit list
steps.description:
What the red, yellow and green commits mean, and the ↑↓ counts on branches.
[Open the Branches panel](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22local%22%5D)

steps.title: Undo almost anything
steps.description:
Undo and Redo on the Commits panel take back your last Git action. The Reflog finds anything else.
[Open the Reflog](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22reflog%22%5D)

steps.title: Tidy up commits
steps.description:
Reword, squash, fixup, drop and reorder commits before you push. What a fixup commit is.
[Open the Commits panel](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22commits%22%5D)

steps.title: Merge or rebase?
steps.description:
Two ways to combine branches, when to use which, and what an interactive rebase is for.
[Open the Branches panel](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22local%22%5D)

steps.title: Copy commits to another branch
steps.description:
Cherry-pick single commits, or move commits made on the wrong branch.
[Open the Branches panel](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22local%22%5D)

steps.title: Put work aside
steps.description:
Stash uncommitted changes to switch tasks, and bring them back later.
[Open the Stash panel](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22stash%22%5D)

steps.title: Work on two branches at once
steps.description:
Worktrees: a second folder with another branch checked out, for urgent fixes or reviews.
[Open the Worktrees tab](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22worktrees%22%5D)

steps.title: Find the commit that broke something
steps.description:
Bisect narrows down the commit that introduced a bug in a few steps.
[Open the Commits panel](command:slothgit.open?%5B%22commits%22%5D)
